title: PuppyDog launch: light airy SaaS product walkthrough on rainbow-gradient canvas
summary: Classic SaaS launch video for an AI product-video tool. Opens on a warm cream canvas with soft peach blur, logo and one-line promise; then the real product UI (a dark analytics dashboard, then the light PuppyDog editor) floats on a pastel rainbow mesh gradient, pushed in, tilted in 3D perspective and cropped to the feature being described. Short centred two-line statements ('Describe the video you want. / PuppyDog writes the script.') bridge the UI scenes; ends on an integrations logo grid and logo end card.
fit_reason: Exactly the 'show the screen' product walkthrough a SaaS portal needs: real UI, calm pacing, plain two-line copy, integrations grid (HighLevel, etc.) and a clean CTA card.

palette.mood: light airy, warm cream with pastel rainbow mesh gradient behind UI

typography.display: neutral grotesk (Inter/SF-like) regular-medium for statements; rounded heavy logotype
typography.size_behaviour: small-medium centred statements (~4-5% frame height), two lines: black line + red/coral second line
typography.notes: Second line or key phrase coloured brand red (#E5352B) e.g. 'fastest way', 'in minutes.' Left-aligned headline variant with small red-bullet checklist ('Creating scenes / Writing script / Generating effects') ticking on.

text_animation: statement fades/blur-in, exits with blur-out + slight upscale
checklist items appear one by one with red bullet
typewriter in the editor prompt box (real product input)
motion: 3D perspective tilt of app window sliding in from right
zoom to a modal/panel then pull back
UI scrolls and cursor clicks inside product
graphic_elements: floating app window with drop shadow and rounded corners
ui_treatment: real screen recordings in floating rounded windows on a gradient, with 3D tilt, zoomed crops on the active panel and dimmed surroundings when a modal is focused

sound.music: light upbeat corporate/electronic, quiet mix (-20 LUFS)
sound.sync: scene changes loosely on phrase changes

signature_moves: real dark UI floating on a pastel rainbow gradient
two-line statement with second line in brand red
integrations logo grid before end card

best_segments.what: cream canvas, logo builds, one-line promise with red emphasis words
dark dashboard UI slides onto rainbow gradient and camera pushes into a panel
left headline 'Create professional product videos in minutes.' + checklist ticking while tilted editor window slides in
'Works with the tools you already use' integration tiles pop in staggered

recreate.how: Remotion/HTML+GSAP: screen recordings as <video> in rounded divs with box-shadow, CSS perspective rotateY for tilt, animated mesh gradient (blurred blobs), blur-in text, logo grid stagger. Matches the explainer-default skill closely.
recreate.prompt: Light, airy SaaS launch video: cream background with soft peach glow, short centred two-line statements with the key phrase in brand colour, real product screen recordings floating in rounded windows over a pastel mesh gradient, slow push-ins and 3D tilts, checklist ticks, integrations grid, logo end card.
